rule: "the pointer is read by attention after the Mamba state spreads it" if the span cuts the lookup's switches by >= 0.6 and the control by <= 0.15; else as 53.4.
rule_53_4: "read through two blocks" if (iii) cuts the lookup's switches by >= 0.6 of the whole change's and (v) by <= 0.15; "one block" if (i) or (ii) alone cuts >= 0.6; "not through attention at the bridge" if (iv) cuts < 0.3 (the Mamba state carries it); else in between.
